patthana24.20:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana24.20:3.1: na araṇaṃ na saññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana24.20:4.1: na araṇaṃ na ganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo gantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana24.20:6.1: na araṇaṃ na oghaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo ogho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana24.20:8.1: na araṇaṃ no yogaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo yogo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana24.20:10.1: na araṇaṃ na nīvaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo nīvaraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana24.20:12.1: na araṇaṃ na parāmāsaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo parāmāso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana24.20:13.1: hetuyā ekaṃ. na saraṇaṃ na sārammaṇaṃ
